an6.38:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an6.38:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.38:1.5: māhaṃ brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.
an6.38:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma sayaṃ abhikkamanto sayaṃ paṭikkamanto evaṃ vakkhati:
an6.38:2.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa, atthi ārambhadhātūti?
an6.38:2.5: yaṃ kho brāhmaṇa ārambhadhātuyā sati ārambhavanto sattā paññāyantī’ti ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro, ayaṃ parakāroti.
an6.38:3.1: taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa atthi nikkhamadhātu …pe…
an6.38:3.9: yaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, upakkamadhātuyā sati upakkamavanto sattā paññāyantī’ti ayaṃ sattānaṃ attakāro, ayaṃ parakāro’ti.
an6.38:4.1: māhaṃ brāhmaṇa, evaṃvādiṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiṃ addasaṃ vā assosiṃ vā.
